title: Documentation index
description: The index of the application documentation shipped in documentation/ (master plan 4.5 check 4), at documentation/index.yaml. For every capability it must hold entries covering seven facets: every field, every validation rule, every permission, every failure state, the risk level, the confirmation rule and every user-visible outcome. The schema fixes the SHAPE of an entry; COVERAGE is the loader's check, so a missing facet fails that one capability with a precise finding instead of making the whole index unreadable. Missing documentation is a failed capability, never an instruction for the model to guess. Authored as YAML; this schema validates the parsed JSON form.

entries.description: The documentation entries. At least one. Entry IDs are unique across the index (checked by the loader).

id.description: The entry ID. Capabilities cite it in doc_refs.

facet.description: What the entry documents: field (needs field), validation_rule (needs rule_id), permission (needs permission), failure_state (needs error_code), risk_level, confirmation_rule or user_visible_outcome (needs outcome). risk_level and confirmation_rule take no subject: there is one of each per capability.

language.description: The language of the documentation text. The manifest's default language must be covered for every capability; other languages are optional.

summary.description: What the documentation says about the subject, in one or two sentences, so the audit can read the claim and not only follow a path.

field.description: For facet field: the name of the documented capability field.

rule_id.description: For facet validation_rule: the ID of the documented validation rule.

permission.description: For facet permission: the documented application permission.

error_code.description: For facet failure_state: the platform error code of the documented failure state.

outcome.description: For facet user_visible_outcome: the outcome ID, matching a success response of the conversation contracts.

path.description: Package-relative path of the document, below documentation/.

anchor.description: Optional heading or element anchor inside the document.
